listing.name: Salvage Office Mod
listing.summary: Adds a building that automates the salvage of resources and hull from wrecks and debris fields within a colony's star system.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a building that automates the salvage of resources and hull from wrecks and debris fields within a colony's star system.

description:
Subject: [0.98a]

Salvage Office Mod (v0.1.5)

Salvage Office Mod for Starsector 0.98a

New version 0.1.5

Added the ability to salvage from wreckage and debris fields:

-AI Cores

-Blueprints

-Weapons

-Drones

- People, soldiers, and many other materials.

This mod adds a new building  called the Salvage Office, which automates the process of reclaiming wrecks within your colony's star system.

Features

Automatic Scanning & Collection: Every 3 days, the building scans the system for derelicts, debris fields, and post-battle remains. It automatically collects Fuel and Supplies found during the process.

Hull Recovery: He has a chance recovered ships and automatically adds to the colony's storage as D-hulls.

Smart Filtering: The mod ignores mission-critical objects and non-playable ships (e.g., space stations).

Planned Features

Extending the system to collect more types of resources.

In-Game Requirements (Planned)

To build the Salvage Office, the colony must have:

Heavy Industry (or Orbital Works)

Patrol HQ (or Military Base/High Command)

https://github.com/Mirellos1/SalvageOffice
